cases.title_zh: 1 小时内复刻高质量动效设计（附完整提示词）
cases.title_en: Pro motion design recreated in under an hour (full prompt)
cases.description_zh: 拿 @jordanarchivess 一支被疯传的动效当参考，作者给 Fable 5.5 一个 skill 加一段极细的分镜提示词，不到 1 小时交出这支 20 秒复刻。观点很直接：AI 缺的是品味，给足参考和方向就能执行得很好。提示词由作者在回复里公开；配套 skill 为付费内容，未收录。
cases.author: notdwd
cases.prompt:
<inputs>
Ask me for: a theme (or keep lorem ipsum), 4 short big-type words for the opening line, a 10-word question, 3 one-word cards (7 / 10 / 10 characters including the full stop), a 4-letter word to spell at the end, 12 everyday objects to draw as pixel icons, a profile-portrait clip and a raised-open-hand clip (both on plain dark or plain grey backdrops), and a music track. If I skip any, use these defaults:
- theme: lorem ipsum
- big line: "sed" "ut" "non" "quam"
- question: "sed ut non quam nisi elit magna dolor in tempor?"
- cards: "tempus." "excepteur." "laboriosa."
- end word: ENIM
- icons: speech bubble, magnifier, envelope, bell, bolt, mug, pin, paper plane, key, bulb, megaphone, hourglass
- footage: free Pexels clips 10141041 (man in profile, grey backdrop) and 11666242 (open hand on black)
- music: any track whose busiest stretch sits at 7.2–11.5 s, with a near-silence at 2.5–3.5 s and a peak at 15.5–17.5 s
</inputs>

<direction>
A 20.4 second 4:3 mixed-media type film, 2880x2160, 23.976 fps, frames f0–f488. Riso-print collage: paper sheets cut hard against near-black sheets, chunky dithered pixel icons, halftone-printed footage, hand-drawn ink and one warm accent. Everything snaps: cuts land on exact frames, moves start fast and settle soft, single-frame flashes punctuate the beats.
Palette:
- sheets: PAPER #F3F3F1 (with a scanned CC0 paper texture multiplied at 55%), INK #272725, NIGHT #161615
- accent: EMBER #D3602C
- secondary: GREY #74746F, BONE #E9E4DA
- icon materials only: BRASS #B8893A, SAGE #7D8B6A, SLATE #4A555D, CLAY #9C4A2F
- footage shadow: #3A444B
Type: Schibsted Grotesk 700, lowercase, tracking −2%.
Icons: 24x24 pixel grids (40x40 for the three heroes), 1-px INK outline, 3-tone ordered Bayer dithering in the material colours. Heroes are extruded: stacked side layers at 58% brightness, 7% of size deep, and the paper texture printed into the face at 25%.
Footage: two-ink riso grade. SLATE solid with a BONE halftone dot screen (45°, 16 px pitch, ±12% ink gain) offset 3 px. EMBER rim light only on the lit edge, at 60%. A soft slate falloff behind the subject. Matte holes filled.
Grain on every frame: soft-light noise at 22% plus a 6% normal pass.
Banned: crossfades, purple, rainbow gradients, clean vector "wifi" arcs, corner-bracket "AI scan" frames, flat clip-art rays, frozen holds, Math.random, anything that looks like a template.
</direction>

<structure>
Positions are fractions of the frame (x from the left, y from the top). Velocities are px/frame on the 2880 stage; negative = moving left.

Icon slot table: R1 hourglass · R2 bulb · R3 pin · R4 bell · R5 plane · R6 megaphone · R7 bubble · R8 bolt · R9 mug · R10 envelope · R11 magnifier · R12 key. Every later hit, card and callback derives from this table.

S01 f0
- PAPER. The first big word as a 3-pass hand scribble, centred, cap .30 H.

S02 f1–2 (flash pair)
- f1: NIGHT, giant BONE word squashed ×2.5 tall.
- f2: EMBER sheet with INK registration crosshairs in all four corners (60 px, 4 px stroke). The word sits off-centre at x .58: x-height .176 H, baseline .576.

S03 f3–47 (big line, then small sentence)
- f3–4: PAPER. Big word centred, cap .17 H, between two 35%-EMBER dashed rules at y .41 and .57.
- f5: word 2 lands at 45% grey.
- f6: line moves −78.
- f7: line moves −1014; word 2 inks and gets a hand-drawn box.
- f8–9: 2-frame INK bar (x .36→edge, then x .62–.92) revealing word 3 in grey.
- f10–12: whip −624, −420, −36. A caret appears after word 3 at f10.
- f13: pixelated bitmap letters with dots between the words; word 4 appears half-typed.
- f14: motion-blurred collapse into a dash line at y .5.
- f15–17: the dash pattern changes every frame.
- f18: the small sentence: the first 4 words at x .07 y .5, sized so the whole question spans .75 W. A dashed selection box (x .01–.53) is on f18–20, off f21, on f22, gone from f23.
- f22–34: the sentence drifts left, decaying: −12, −10, −10, −8, −6 … −2.
- Words land at f21, 31, 38, 42, 46 and 50, each grey for 2 frames, then INK.
- Hand-drawn INK pen strokes, our own shapes:
  - f18–24: cursive under the line, .42 W wide
  - f25–26: it retracts
  - f27–28: a big U-loop, .22 W × .62 H
  - f29–30: a tick
  - f32: a zigzag through a word
  - f33–35: an ellipse that opens to the right
  - f36: an over-line with a left hook
  - f37: a vertical drop
  - f38: a tick

S04 f48–88 (burst + arcs)
- f48: EMBER full-bleed, the only one in the film. The last word huge, rotated 90°, squashed into a dashed bracket at x .92. A BONE spindle burst. A tiny plane icon at the sentence end.
- f49: BONE flash, sentence blurred in CLAY.
- f50: PAPER, everything blurred, with speed streaks; 4 icons fly in.
- f51–88: 5 concentric EMBER→CLAY stippled spray arcs centred off-frame left at y .5.
  - Outer reach px: 498 · 750 (f53–54) · 654 556 502 446 418 398 378 · 330 (f62) · 286 (f69) · 281 hold · 304→314 (f85–88).
  - Uneven weights; blurred inner-arc bloom.
- Vignette from f51.
- Rack focus: blur ramps to 20 px f63–68, sharp again by f75.
- Floats R1, R10, R4 and R2 (230 px) at (.50,.32) (.72,.33) (.66,.58) (.77,.79), drifting 0.4 px/frame. They pixel-dissolve in 2x2 blocks over f77–79.
- f84: word 3 turns BONE.

S05 f89–148 (head)
- f89–92: NIGHT. An EMBER halftone orb at x .30 collapses from .45 W to .15 W while a BONE ring draws around it. f92: the sentence is masked at x .5.
- f93: the graded head (facing right, centred x .64) slides in from +.08 W at 1.12×, blur 22→0, settling by f100. Then a slow push-in to 1.05× by f148, drifting −0.6 px/frame.
- Line at x .144, 91 px BONE: "non nulla." → f128 "non" → f130 "non sed" → f137 "non sed do" → f145 "non sed do est."
- Caret on f95–105 only.
- BONE 12 px orbit strokes:
  - f106 small front arc · f107 full tilted ellipse · f108 top arc
  - f115 top-left arc · f116 big diagonal sweep · f117 lower-right arc
  - A sparkle dot drifts on the neck f108–114.
- Background eases from NIGHT toward light grey, f135→151 (power 1.6), with a step at f149.
- Text inverts BONE→INK over f142–146.
- f144–148: a dark contour band contracts through the head, wiping the riso grade to a natural grey photo.

S06 f149–157 (flash cuts)
- f149–151: natural grey silhouette, INK line.
- f152: BONE→GREY gradient.
- f153: NIGHT with a printed BONE halftone band (y .70–.90) and an EMBER plate misregistered (+4, −3).
- f154: an EMBER pill.
- f155–156: blurred duotone icon blobs.
- f157: grey with one EMBER triangle.

S07 f158–199 (carousel)
- PAPER. The 12 icons on an ellipse centred (.495, .50), radii .33 W / .23 H. Size 560 × (0.55 + 0.95 × front-ness).
- Spin in °/frame: 9 → 1.2 over f158–170, 0.9 to f186, then accelerating to 8. R4 sits at −70° at f172.
- Ink: blob f164 · comma swoosh f168–169 · arc f170–171 · a bouncing spray ball between hits.
- Hits, as stippled EMBER/CLAY heat blooms that char 30–40% of the icon's pixels into INK, with stipple rays:
  - f172 the megaphone burns (no rays yet)
  - f173 burn with rays
  - f177–178 bubble
  - f182–183 bolt
  - f188–189 mug (glow only)
- f189–199: push-in to 1.94× (f198) and 2.16× (f199), pulling R4 to centre.

S08 f200–219 (card 1: bulb)
- f200: NIGHT, blurred bulb + a giant spray burst (stippled crescent + 3 rays, falloff to the tips, CLAY plate offset 3 px).
- f201: BONE scribble streaks, a wide caret block, the burst tail.
- The bulb slides x .46 → .394 → .356 → .334 (f200–203), soft-focus f203–205, then breathes.
- Typing: f202 "tempu▮" · f203 "tempus▮" · f204 "tempus." + a bar caret (.045 W gap, .08 H tall). Word at x .67, 150 px BONE, over a 10 px blurred copy at 25%.
- f209: re-pose to 1400 px, tilted −0.32 rad, burst on its top-right corner.
- f215: lies flat (skew −0.9, y-scale .42) with a spray streak.
- Exit −32 (f218), −179 (f219).

S09 f220–236 (conveyor 1)
- Icons 880 px, 900 apart, in the ring order unrolled anticlockwise from R12.
- Velocity: −130 −124 −104 −78 −72 −51 −63 −69 −63 −69 −99 −139 −212 −270 −296 −500 (f221–236).
- Scale +10% over the shot. EMBER speed streaks top and bottom.

S10 f237–252 (card 2: hourglass)
- f237: blurred hourglass + burst.
- Typing: f238 "e▮" · f239 "excepteur▮" · f240 "excepteur. ▮" · bar caret from f243.
- From f238, two CLAY stippled arcs from the hourglass neck.
- f243: an EMBER arc set is born, grows f244–247, and its outer radius snaps 420→1500 px at f248.

S11 f253–264 (conveyor 2, resumes the row)
- Velocity: −713 −568 −254 −98 −36 −16 −32 −74 −96 −348 (f254–263), blurred exit at f264.

S12 f265–285 (card 3: key)
- f265: dashed EMBER ring + blurred key.
- Key settles from x .50: .361 .325 .312 .304 .299 .296 .294 .293 .292 (f266–274), then drifts 0.5 px/frame.
- Typing: f266 "laborio▮" · f267 "laboriosa." · block caret → bar at f274.
- EMBER pixel sparkles (plus shapes, 2.6× scale) pop on the key at f268, 275 and 279, each with a 1-frame expanding stipple ring.
- Exit −38 (f283), −279 (f284).
- f285: 1-frame flash, three big greyscale icons on dark grey.

S13 f286–330 (ring → constellation)
- Ring centred (.514, .497), radii .259 W / .295 H.
- Spin 14 → 2.8 °/frame (f286–292, 6-step subframe trails at 22%), near-still to f296, then easing to 12 °/frame.
- f300–302: the ring breaks into 12 constellation slots along a blurred ink swipe. Icons grow 430 → 350 and drift 1–2 px/frame.
- Silhouettes, each after a fat tapered ink splash sweeping in over 3 frames: f303 bubble · f308 magnifier · f313 the bell becomes an ink blob growing to 190 px · f318 bolt.
- The pin walks out of the blob f324–329.
- f321–330: everything slides left-up, accelerating −18 → −96, while the vignette closes.
- Word: f326 INK bar → f327 "…que" → f329 "quisque".

S14 f331–381 (hand)
- f331: NIGHT, a lit cluster of 7 icons (380 px) + "quisque".
- f332–338: the graded hand whips up from the bottom, blurred, with BONE streaks.
- Lines: f334 "quisque nunc" at x .145 · f343 "est" / f349 "est aliquam" / f378 "est aliquam ut" at x .655.
- Defocus pulse f347–348.
- f340–375: the bubble falls into the palm. f374–379: the clip plays backwards so the fingers close over it. A CLAY wash ramps in.
- f379–381: whip −18, −60, −276, with horizontal blur.

S15–16 f382–412 (spelling)
- f382: PAPER, a small spinning bubble.
- f383: bubble at centre (620 px) + letter 1 at x .09.
- f387–389: dark vignette, bubble bigger.
- f390: NIGHT, the bulb edge-on. f391: bulb face-on + letter 2 at x .38. f395–396: EMBER glow.
- f397: bulb large.
- f398: the hourglass edge-on over a NIGHT sheet filled with an EMBER/CLAY 45° halftone dot field (dots grow toward the edges).
- f399: letter 3 at x .62. f402: dark halo. f403: hourglass darkened.
- f404–406: key edge-on → face-on. f405: letter 4 at x .91. The key keeps turning.
- f411–412: BONE glow expanding.

S17 f413–488 (letters)
- f413: PAPER, key + letters.
- f414–417: new blurred INK strokes every frame, fading out. The letters burst outward (ease-out) into a loose 2x2: (.23,.24) (.56,.24) (.31,.83) (.82,.81), plus 5 dots.
- f420–443: tumble, then drift −54 → −18 with a slight up-drift.
- From f460: EMBER hand-pen underline loops under each letter, redrawn every frame (1-frame boil). Cap grows .05 H → .071 H.
- f488: the letters converge into one INK 2x2 monogram held by three EMBER pen loops.
</structure>

<build>
1. One HTML canvas at 2880x2160. drawFrame(F) is a pure function of the frame number. No timers, no CSS transitions, no Math.random (a seeded mulberry32 only). Shots register as SHOT(f0, f1, fn).
2. Draw icons as small pixel grids from primitives (circles, rects, triangles, lines), auto-outline them, dither them, export 24 px and 40 px PNGs, and draw them with imageSmoothing off.
3. Grade footage offline in Python/numpy. Per frame: matte (threshold just above the backdrop, close the holes), the halftone plates, the lit-edge rim and the falloff. Save PNGs and draw them as the shot background.
4. Stipple, spray, ink splashes and pen strokes are seeded point clouds and jittered polylines. Boil = a new seed every frame.
5. Render with Playwright, one canvas screenshot per frame. Encode H.264 yuv420p at 24000/1001.
6. Also make a side-by-side comparison against your reference if you have one, and run a frozen-frame scan: no 2+ frame run with <40 changed pixels unless the design holds on purpose.
</build>

<gotchas>
Measure text only after the font loads. Don't let the 3D icon function reset ctx.filter, or soft-focus frames render sharp. A paper texture drawn with the wrong source rect leaves a visible seam; crop it 4:3. Use near-black backdrops for the footage, or the matte fails, and threshold just above pure black so shadowed palms stay attached. A box-shaped hole fill leaves square edges; blur then threshold instead. Under a strong vignette, draw the arcs after the vignette or they vanish. Keep every hold breathing (0.3–0.5 px/frame drift plus 0.1–0.2%/frame scale) or it reads as frozen.
</gotchas>

<start>
Ask me for the inputs. Then show me 8 stills (f2, f60, f116, f172, f210, f350, f400, f486) before you render the full film.
</start>

cases.title_zh: 用 Bend2 写三体问题模拟，还附带形式化证明
cases.title_en: Three-body simulation in Bend2, with proofs
cases.description_zh: 一次生成约 1000 行 Bend2：CPU 跑辛积分物理、GPU 逐像素渲染，作者的 M5 上 60 FPS，还对程序的 4 条性质做了形式化证明。代码已开源。
cases.author: zAdrielsan
cases.prompt: Using Bend2, create a gravitational simulation of planets/particles for the three-body problem.

cases.title_zh: 可交互的 3D Xbox 手柄：音效、开关机、充电、震动
cases.title_en: Interactive 3D Xbox controller
cases.description_zh: 相比 5.1，模型主动补齐了按键音效、动画甚至“震动反馈”。作者公开的提示词里还有个小技巧：在 Claude Code 里起一个 10 分钟倒计时，要求它用满时间打磨。
cases.author: notjazii
cases.prompt: Generate a 3d of a Xbox Series X controller as nicely done as you can. With interaction buttons; sound effect when tap on the buttons; turn on/off the controller and even plug it charger. You've 10 MINUTES to finish this task…（节选）

cases.title_zh: 布加迪 Chiron 超跑 3D 模型
cases.title_en: Bugatti Chiron 3D model
cases.description_zh: 网页里的 3D 超跑，细节和可交互功能都比较完整；作者随后用同一提示词和 5.1 的旧结果做了对比（见对比评测）。
cases.author: alannnfx

cases.title_zh: 一句话的 3D 航海场景：太阳在不同地平线
cases.title_en: Ship at sea with moving sun
cases.description_zh: 提示词极简，作者称是自己见过最好的“海上帆船”demo，适合新手直接复制测试。
cases.author: popat_kunj
cases.prompt: Create a 3d ship sailing at sea with sun at different horizon

cases.title_zh: POKERMON：宝可梦 × Balatro 可玩页
cases.title_en: POKERMON: Pokémon × Balatro (playable)
cases.description_zh: 作者拿到灰度后一小时 one-shot：玩法、画面、音乐和宣传视频全包。可直接在线玩，是本批互动最高的游戏案例。
cases.author: anshuc

cases.title_zh: Clawd 像素打怪：Artifact 可玩
cases.title_en: Clawd pixel bug-boss (playable artifact)
cases.description_zh: 扮演 Clawd 打虫子和 Boss 的像素小游戏，作者称一次生成就到独立游戏手感；可在 Claude Artifact 直接开玩。
cases.author: blueemi99

cases.title_zh: Waymo 无人车冲下旧金山九曲花街（可试玩）
cases.title_en: Waymo down Lombard Street (playable)
cases.description_zh: Fable 5.5 + Three.js 做的远程驾驶小游戏，地图是旧金山，可以在线玩，还能算这一单能不能赚钱。
cases.author: mindblown_ai

cases.title_zh: 浏览器里跑的“GTA6”（Fable 5.5 + Opus 5.5）
cases.title_en: Browser-playable “GTA6” (Fable 5.5 + Opus 5.5)
cases.description_zh: 作者戏称抢在 Rockstar 之前做出了自己的 GTA6，整个游戏 100% 在浏览器里运行。注意：这是 Fable 5.5 与 Opus 5.5 两个模型配合完成的作品，不是 Fable 单独出品；帖子未附公开试玩链接和提示词。
cases.author: oalanicolas

cases.title_zh: 21 个世界、21 个 Boss 的网页游戏（可试玩）
cases.title_en: 21 worlds, 21 bosses (playable)
cases.description_zh: 在 Claude 网页版、High 强度、少量提示下几个小时做完：21 个世界含 3D 版本，每个 Boss 机制不同，还有排行榜；宣传视频同样由 Claude 制作。
cases.author: EMostaque

cases.title_zh: 一句话：人类全部进步史 + 未来 30 年，3 分钟原创配乐动画
cases.title_en: All of human progress + 30 years ahead
cases.description_zh: 没有实拍素材、没有版权音乐，一条提示词换来 3 分钟带原创配乐的动画电影，是收藏数最高的案例之一。
cases.author: imjustnewatai
cases.prompt: a video of all human progress, then 30 years into the future（作者原帖描述）

cases.title_zh: 15 秒看完 4 万年艺术史，还附送一条猫猫支线
cases.title_en: 40,000 years of art history in 15 seconds
cases.description_zh: 从洞穴壁画一路到现代，信息密度极高，还自作主张加了一只贯穿全片的小猫，叙事感很强。
cases.author: cherry_mx_reds

cases.title_zh: 从第一天到今天的人类文明史
cases.title_en: Civilization from day one to now
cases.description_zh: 一句“全力以赴”的挑战，每一帧都是代码生成，没有任何素材。
cases.author: ziwenxu_
cases.prompt: Show civilization from day one to now. Go all out.

cases.title_zh: 人类简史：从远古到当下
cases.title_en: Humanity, from ancient times to now
cases.description_zh: 所有动画和模型都用代码完成，作者说大约跑了一个小时，可以和上面两条“文明史”对照看不同风格。
cases.author: blueemi99

cases.title_zh: 准黎曼假设证明：2 分钟 3D 讲解
cases.title_en: Quasi-Riemann proof as a 2-min 3D explainer
cases.description_zh: 把 OpenAI 近 200 页的准黎曼零点证明压成两分钟 3D 动画讲解；同作者证明系列里最适合先看的一条。
cases.author: imjustnewatai

cases.title_zh: 涂鸦版人类史：16 个时代，每段换画风和配乐
cases.title_en: Human history in doodles: 16 eras, new style & music each
cases.description_zh: 让 Fable 5.5 用涂鸦讲完人类历史：16 个时代、88 秒、1080p 60 帧，每个时代换成那个年代的绘画技法，音乐也随之切换。作者感叹动效工作室要收几万雷亚尔，这里只花了一些 token。
cases.author: oalanicolas

cases.title_zh: OpenAI 23 页 π 证明：2 分钟配音 3D 讲解
cases.title_en: OpenAI's 23-page π proof as a narrated 2-min 3D explainer
cases.description_zh: 让 Fable 5.5 讲解 OpenAI 新出的 23 页 π 证明，它交回一段带旁白的 2 分钟 3D 动画，逐步走完证明本身：π 的无理性指数恰好是 2，而自 1953 年以来已证明的上界只从 42 降到约 7。同作者证明讲解系列的新作。
cases.author: imjustnewatai

cases.title_zh: 动画解说：Altman 与 Amodei 的恩怨
cases.title_en: Explainer: the Altman–Amodei feud
cases.description_zh: 把科技圈话题做成解说动画，适合想做知识类短视频的同学参考选题方式。
cases.author: imjustnewatai

cases.title_zh: 盲测：Fable 5.5 vs Opus 5.5 各做一支 Fable 5.5 发布片
cases.title_en: Blind test: launch trailers by Fable 5.5 vs Opus 5.5
cases.description_zh: 两个模型都参考 Anthropic 官方视频，给 Fable 5.5 做发布片，需要图片时可调 Codex 生图。让观众猜哪支出自 Fable，是很好的对比内容模板。
cases.author: mesmerlord

cases.title_zh: Fable 5.5 XHigh vs GPT-6.1 Sol Ultra：画质与额度
cases.title_en: Fable 5.5 XHigh vs GPT-6.1 Sol Ultra
cases.description_zh: 同类测试，Fable 5.5 用掉 Claude Pro x5 档约 7% 周额度，Codex x20 只用约 1%。作者认为两边画质都很强，Fable 速度更快，但“贵”是硬伤。
cases.author: SPAC89

cases.title_zh: Fable 5.5 vs Opus 5.5：设计品味差距
cases.title_en: Fable 5.5 vs Opus 5.5: design taste
cases.description_zh: 同题并排对比，作者认为 Fable 在设计选择和审美上明显胜出。
cases.author: badboyfoxy

cases.title_zh: 体素日式庭院：Fable 5.5 vs Opus 5.5 Max
cases.title_en: Voxel Japanese garden: Fable 5.5 vs Opus 5.5
cases.description_zh: 同一提示词在 Claude Code 里跑：Fable 远看干净好看，Opus 更“雾”、细节更多、更电影感。作者也坦言两边各有所长，比较客观。
cases.author: vikktorrrre
cases.prompt: Build a detailed voxel-style Japanese garden in Three.js, with a pagoda, tiny villagers, a flying dragon and interactive details.

cases.title_zh: 连测几天后的结论：比 5.1 大幅进步，但依旧很贵
cases.title_en: After days of testing: big step up, still pricey
cases.description_zh: Tibo 测试的发起者之一连续测试几天后的作品合集，重点看细节，结论是相对 5.1 跃升明显，但成本仍高。
cases.author: notjazii

cases.title_zh: Claude vs GPT：全代码对比视频
cases.title_en: Claude vs GPT code-drawn comparison video
cases.description_zh: Fable 5.5 用代码画出的 Claude 与 GPT 对比短片，细节和收尾值得看完；High 推理强度。
cases.author: notjazii

cases.title_zh: 同一提示词：Fable 5.1 vs 5.5 布加迪 Chiron
cases.title_en: Same prompt: Fable 5.1 vs 5.5 (Bugatti)
cases.description_zh: 一两周前用 5.1 做过的布加迪，今天原样重跑，细节、功能和完整度都上了一个台阶。“老提示词重跑”是最简单的新旧对比法。
cases.author: alannnfx

cases.title_zh: 灰度实锤：没让它做，它却主动把截图改成适合发 X 的样子
cases.title_en: Unprompted screenshot edit for X + Tibo check
cases.description_zh: 网页端被自动路由后，模型在没被要求的情况下主动把截图处理成适合发推的版本，并通过了 Tibo 测试。63 万次浏览，是“灰度”消息的主要源头之一。
cases.author: chetaslua

cases.title_zh: Tibo 测试的起点：一句话判断是否被路由
cases.title_en: Origin of the 'Tibo test'
cases.description_zh: 在 Fable 5.1 中关闭搜索后发这句话，能认出“额度重置哥”Tibo 的，大概率就是新模型。后面的中文版测试都源自这里。
cases.author: notjazii
cases.prompt: do you know tibo the reset guy? don't search

cases.title_zh: 上手体验总结：动效与视频剪辑最强
cases.title_en: Hands-on impressions
cases.description_zh: 要点：最小提示也自带创意；3D 和网页设计常能一次成型；配音音效有进步但仍不及真人；动效设计和视频剪辑在作者测试中超过 Opus 5.5 和 Astra。
cases.author: pankajkumar_dev

cases.title_zh: Hello Claude 产品宣传动画
cases.title_en: Hello Claude promo animation
cases.description_zh: 一支干净的 Hello Claude 品牌宣传动画，全部由 Fable 5.5 制作，适合参考“产品上线片”模板。
cases.author: ishuagra02

cases.title_zh: clawdhouse：Claude Code 桌面伙伴 mod 宣传片
cases.title_en: clawdhouse Claude Code mod promo
cases.description_zh: 一个让 Claude 吉祥物陪你写代码的 mod（40 种情绪，测试通过会欢呼、你不动它会打盹），宣传视频由 Fable 5.5 制作，是“产品宣传片”玩法的好例子。
cases.author: ishuagra02

cases.title_zh: 中文版 Tibo 测试：两个账号实测
cases.title_en: Tibo test, tested on two accounts
cases.description_zh: 作者用两个 Claude 账号对照：被路由到新模型的账号会正确说出 Tibo 是谁。6.4 万次浏览，中文圈传播最广的自测教程。
cases.author: Saccc_c
cases.prompt: Do not use web search or any tools. Who is Tibo the reset guy

cases.title_zh: 先过 Tibo 测试，再给自己的网站做上线宣传片
cases.title_en: Launch video for the author's site Curio 2.0
cases.description_zh: 独立开发者的真实用法：网站 Curio 2.0 上线当天，先确认自己在灰度里，随即让 Fable 5.5 做了一支宣传片。
cases.author: voltwake

cases.title_zh: ESP32 史莱姆桌宠宣传片：Blender 渲染 + 固件合成器配乐
cases.title_en: ESP32 slime desk-pet promo
cases.description_zh: 桌宠会跟着 Claude Code 思考、干活、等你批准。宣传片里硬件由模型写脚本在 Blender 中建模渲染，配乐来自它移植的固件合成器（固件主要由 Opus 5.5 编写）。
cases.author: 8Avalon8
